featured_reviews.name: Alan K M
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 5 Stars of Disgrace – Seva Niketan

This is by far the worst place I have ever stayed. The staff openly smoke, drink, and use weed in areas where they know there are no cameras. Rooms are never cleaned — they’re filthy, unhygienic, and the beds are infested with bed bugs.

The lady at the front desk seems more interested in picking fights than helping guests. They allow cops and GST officers to walk in at any hour, but paying guests are locked out if they return late. Even after taking your money, they won’t open the gate or show basic courtesy.

The bathrooms are always clogged and dirty, and the canteen is outright disgusting — you can see rats running around the kitchen. It’s shocking that a place run under Christian management treats guests with such disrespect and neglect.

To make things worse, they refuse to provide any proper proof of payment — no bills, no receipts, nothing.

A completely mismanaged, unhygienic, and unsafe place. Stay away.

I usually don’t leave reviews, but I feel compelled to share my disappointing experience. First off, the customer service was incredibly lacking. The staff seemed uninterested and unhelpful, which made the entire experience feel very uncomfortable. I waited much longer than expected for my order, and when it finally arrived, it was cold and not at all what I had asked for.

The ambiance was nothing to write home about either. The place was poorly lit, and the decor felt outdated and drab. To make matters worse, the bathroom was dirty, and the overall cleanliness of the restaurant was far below acceptable standards.

I also found the pricing to be absurd for the quality of food and service I received. It’s clear that this place is not focused on its customers, and I won’t be returning. Definitely not worth the hype.

featured_reviews.name: Rafiya farheen
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took this PG for one month, but unfortunately I had to leave within just 3 days due to serious issues.
Firstly, the PG is not organized or properly managed by the owner, Mansi. There is no hygiene maintained. The washroom and washbasin are extremely dirty and unclean. The kitchen is not properly accessible — only a few people are allowed to use it, while others are restricted. You cannot cook properly.
This is the month of Ramzan, and when I raised concerns regarding basic facilities, my complaints were ignored. The warden clearly refused washing clothes saying, “If I get time, I will do,” which is very unprofessional. There is also theft happening — many residents’ belongings are going missing.
Most importantly, there is no proper space or freedom to offer namaz peacefully. When I complained about these issues, the warden behaved rudely and misbehaved. After the owner Mansi leaves, arguments continue till 2 AM, disturbing everyone and that cause me a mental Harrasement.
The warden is a 19-year-old girl from Nepal who does not understand our language properly and is not capable of managing the PG responsibly.
There is a prepaid system — if you pay for one full month, there is strictly no refund under any circumstances. Even though the facilities and commitments promised on the first day were not fulfilled, they refused to consider any refund.
Because of all this, I lost my full amount of ₹6,000 within just 3 days.
Overall, it was a very stressful and disappointing experience. Basic hygiene, proper management, safety, and respect for residents are completely lacking.

Unfortunately, the staying experience at this hostel has been far from satisfactory.

The food quality is below average, and the hostel uses sub-standard dairy products and ingredients for the students. However, when the owner’s family’s food is prepared, they use branded and high-quality products. What feels even more unfair is that the owner often takes food from the hostel kitchen for his own home and even sends it to his friends, while we, the paying students, are left with inferior meals.

The hygiene in the hostel is another major issue. The place is not well-maintained, and the rooms are sometimes not  mopped. As a result, cockroaches and lizards are common in the rooms. Many students fall sick frequently, but the owner shows little to no concern about this.

Additionally, the staff aunts and night warden are often rude and unprofessional. They shout frequently, creating a stressful environment for the students. Only Sunita Aunty is kind and nice to students.

Overall, I feel that the hostel management prioritises their own needs over the well-being of the students. I sincerely hope the owner takes feedback seriously and makes the necessary improvements for the health and comfort of everyone staying here.
